🦉Our Coaching

Our short term intensive training for DET can be completed in 5 sessions! The perfect length for quick testprep. The training includes sessions that prepare you for all question types of the DET. We are among the very select group of companies that understand and thoroughly prepare you to successfully attempt the complex question types that DET presents you with.

The course will include, but is not limited to:

Understanding word forms

DET Reading Secrets

Filling missing letters

Parts of speech

Understanding Context

Our training comes with a complimentary 10 full-length mock test pack specifically designed to simulate the actual DET. The test is also fully mobile ready! Practice anywhere!

Questions about Personalised training

Here are a few questions about our personalised training that people usually want to know the answers to. If your question isn’t answered here, you can always contact Usand we will answer it for you!

Is it only online? + −

Yes! The training is fully online. Keeping in-line with the fully contact free nature of the DET test, our training prepares you for the DET in a way that makes you fully ready. Contact free test and contact free training!

I want to be training only in one module. Is that possible? + −

The questions in DET are fully integrated. Each question type tests multiple areas of lanauge. So like other tests, DET is not amenable to modular coaching.

I live in another country, can I train with you? + −

Oh yeah! 😀 We have had people from Australia, Morocco, Iran, Nigeria, and several other places come to us for training. If you wish to visit India for our training, we welcome you with unfettered delight. If you wish to train online, we can do that too! Let us help you get started!

Can I only take the DET Mock Tests? + −

If you just wish to have a whole lot of practice material for the duolingo English Test, you can purchase a full suite of DET practice tests here.

I am still not sure! What do I do? + −

Relax. If you just want to talk to someone about the test, please free to call us, or visit us. We will always be ready to assist you! And talking to us is free. If you have a question about the test, we would love to answer it!
